blurb: Guests can rent boats including party barges and water toys, take lake tours aboard the Nordic Marie or Veranda, and stay in motel rooms, cabins, or a lodge overlooking the marina. The marina also offers boat slips for rent and a seasonal restaurant. Activities include fishing, scuba diving, biking, kayaking, and ATV riding.
extraNote: Boat rental cancellation: refund less $50 if cancelled outside 4 days; no refund inside 4 days · Lodging cancellation: deposit refunded less $25 if cancelled outside 14 days; deposit forfeited inside 14 days; full reservation forfeited inside 24 hours · 2 night minimum on weekends and 3 night minimum on holidays for lodging · A raincheck for boat rental granted only if boat not boarded and at management discretion · Crystal Springs Marina Village, Lake Ouachita · Season: May 1st thru September 6th; Off Season: September 7th thru April 30th
